user.title: Choose Connection
user.description: Choose how PyTap receives the passive Tigo byte stream.

tcp.title: Connect to Tigo Gateway
tcp.description: Provide the connection details for your Tigo gateway.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your Tigo gateway.

serial.title: Serial / Home Assistant Proxy
serial.description: Select a local serial adapter or a proxy port. For a proxy, add an ESPHome device with serial_proxy to Home Assistant first. Offline ports can be entered manually. PyTap only listens; it never writes to the bus.

data_description.serial_port: Choose the actual port, including when a device exposes multiple proxies.
data_description.baud_rate: UART speed (default: 38400). Framing is fixed to 8N1 with no flow control.

modules_menu.title: Configure Modules

discovery.title: Module Discovery
discovery.description: Automatically discover optimizers from passive bus traffic. No bus commands are sent. Names are based on barcodes, string grouping starts as Discovered, and rated panel power is unknown until edited. Turn this off to track only modules you add manually.

data_description.string: String group label (e.g. A, B, East, West). Required for aggregate energy tracking.
data_description.name: A friendly name for this optimizer (e.g. Panel_01).
data_description.peak_power: The peak power rating of this panel in watts (STC). Used to calculate performance percentage. Default: 455 Wp.

init.title: PyTap Options
init.description:
{modules_list}

Discovery mode: **{discovery_mode}**. Module and discovery changes are applied with Save and close.

change_discovery.title: Module Discovery
change_discovery.description: Enable passive discovery of new optimizers. Disabling this stops adding new modules but keeps modules already discovered. Removed modules are ignored until explicitly added again. Save and close applies this setting.

module_details.title: Module Details
module_details.description: Edit the optimizer name, string group, and rated panel power. Barcode-based entity IDs and energy history are preserved. Save and close applies the changes.

data_description.peak_power: Enter the panel's rated watts, or 0 if unknown. Performance percentages are unavailable until the rating is known.

change_connection.title: Change Connection Settings
change_connection.description: Choose the connection type. Your modules, entity IDs, reporting settings, and energy history are preserved.

change_tcp.title: Change Connection Settings
change_tcp.description: Update the IP address and port of your Tigo gateway.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your Tigo gateway.

change_serial.title: Serial / Home Assistant Proxy
change_serial.description: Select a local adapter or an ESPHome serial-proxy port already added to Home Assistant. You can retain or manually enter an offline endpoint. Connection changes are saved immediately and reload PyTap.

data_description.serial_port: Select the actual port; the current port is not probed while PyTap is using it.
data_description.baud_rate: UART speed (default: 38400). Framing is fixed to 8N1 with no flow control.

data_description.string: String group label (e.g. A, B, East, West). Required for aggregate energy tracking.
data_description.name: A friendly name for this optimizer (e.g. Panel_01).
data_description.peak_power: The peak power rating of this panel in watts (STC). Used to calculate performance percentage. Default: 455 Wp.

change_reporting.title: Reporting Settings
change_reporting.description:
Configure how this integration delivers data to Home Assistant.

When **Live reporting** is enabled (default), readings are pushed as they arrive from the gateway with sub-second latency.

Turn it off to cache readings and deliver a time-weighted average instead — you'll set the interval on the next screen. This reduces CPU and I/O load for installations with many panels.

data_description.live_reporting: Deliver each reading as it arrives from the gateway (recommended for most setups). Turn this off to set an averaging interval.

set_interval.title: Reporting Interval
set_interval.description: Readings are cached and delivered to Home Assistant as a time-weighted average once per interval.

data_description.write_interval: How often (in seconds) to push time-weighted averaged updates to Home Assistant. Range: 5–300. Default: 30 seconds.

change_stale.title: Stale Readings
change_stale.description: Choose what live panel readings (power, voltage, current, temperature, duty cycle, RSSI and performance) do when a panel stops sending valid reports, for example at night or during radio dropouts. Energy totals are not affected.

data_description.stale_action: Unavailable: show readings as unavailable. Zero: report 0 for power, voltage, current and performance (other readings become unavailable). Hold: keep the last values, including after a restart.
data_description.stale_timeout: How long without a valid report before a panel counts as stale (60–600 s). In averaged reporting mode the reporting interval is added.
